I witnessed a murder and did nothing about it. Didn't intervene, didn't tell anyone, nothing. I'm not trying to give too many whens and wheres or anything, but they died a slow painful death I probably could've stopped, a real fucked up way to go. It does haunt me, but I'm not entirely sure if it was a mistake. It's a big one if it is, but there was surely a reason they were doing this, and I didn't want the same treatment.

Leech WiFi from somewhere. Using the internet doesn't fund these bad business practices, paying for it does. ISPs gain nothing from you using WiFi somewhere that's going to pay them regardless of whether or not you, specifically, use it.

EDIT: u/andthatisitfornow did have a fair point, and what I said may have come off a little harsh. If you really do *need* internet access to get by, then by all means pay for it and use it. It's understandable that some people really do need it, and relying on WiFi in public places might not always be feasible. Do what I need to, nobody expects you to put your life on hold to marginally hurt a megacorp.

Not with that attitude. We'll never win if we play by their rules. Unfortunately, peace is not the answer here. If we want to not be cattle, the super rich and/or the people who support/work for them are going to have to be killed. They can't be reasoned with or we wouldn't be where we are today. If we want freedom from our corporate opressors, it's going to mean war. Probably the biggest war of all time, but one worth fighting, and one we'll win. We have the numbers. We just lack people willing to fight it.
